artworks.title: By the Caliban
artworks.medium: softground etching with aquatint in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays multiple curving and interwoven lines, depicting an abstract composition reminiscent of human figures in motion. The central figures are elongated and posed dynamically, suggesting movement and fluidity. The lines create a scene that could evoke a group performing a coordinated dance or ritual. The figures emerge from a textured background, adding depth and complexity. Overlapping dark and light areas could be perceived as trees or a forest setting, providing context for the activity depicted.

artworks.title: Three Acrobats
artworks.medium: lithograph with lithotint in black on wove paper
artworks.dimensions:
image (irregular): 38.1 × 27.31 cm (15 × 10 3/4 in.)
sheet: 55.88 x 35.56 cm (22 x 14 in.)
artworks.description: The image showcases a series of swirling lines and shapes creating an abstract composition. These lines form a central figure resembling a human form, surrounded by flowing forms that may evoke imagery of motion or a dancer. The surrounding shapes and shadows suggest movement and energy, with elements reminiscent of draped fabric or foliage. The contrasting light and dark areas add depth and texture to the image.

artworks.title: Orchard of Bounties
artworks.medium: lithograph with lithotint in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image features several figures in different postures. The sketch shows full-body depictions of the figures, some standing, one crouched, and another sitting with a child. The outlines of the figures are outlined with flowing lines. The figures have different hairstyles, including long wavy hair and shorter or tied-back hair. The figures are not wearing clothes. They interact with each other through subtle gestures. In the background, there is a faint outline of trees in the upper-right corner, suggesting an outdoor setting. No additional objects or jewelry are visible in this monochrome artwork.

artworks.title: Orchard of Bounties
artworks.medium: lithograph with lithotint in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows fluid lines and gentle curves forming an abstract representation of human forms. Dark lines and washes suggest gestural outlines, hinting at adults and children interacting in a natural setting. Rounded shapes and elongated bodies connect to familiar objects like people in a relaxed social gathering. The background includes loosely sketched foliage-like forms, adding to the abstract scene, enhancing the impression of a serene, familial environment.

artworks.title: Free of Clouds
artworks.medium: lithograph with lithotint in black on wove paper

artworks.title: Nymphs of the Stream
artworks.medium: lithograph with lithotint in black on wove paper
artworks.description: Two individuals are depicted in the image, with their full upper bodies shown, extending down to the waist. The person on the right is positioned facing forward with arms raised above their head. The individual on the left appears to be leaning slightly forward with their head near the shoulder of the other person. The image's style highlights delicate facial features, with both having fine, curling lines suggesting wavy hair. Both figures are unclothed and are composed using light, sparse lines giving an impression of softness. The background consists of abstract patterns of shading and smudges, predominantly on the left side, creating a textured contrast against the otherwise plain backdrop. There is no visible jewelry or objects in the image.

artworks.title: Stir of Shadowed Melodies
artworks.medium: lithograph with lithotint in black on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures. The drawing features several figures in various poses, some standing and others seated. The figures are rendered with fluid lines and washed ink that gives a soft quality to the composition. The shading is minimal, enhancing the sense of lightness and movement within the group. The lines convey interaction between the figures.

artworks.title: Release at the Gates
artworks.medium: lithograph with lithotint in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows fluid, curving lines forming human figures in various poses. The figures are intertwined, creating a dynamic flow. Light and shadow create a pattern resembling tree branches and leaves around the figures.

artworks.title: Release at the Gates
artworks.medium: lithograph with lithotint in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is a monochromatic drawing featuring several figures in various poses with their bodies shown. Each individual appears to be nude and they are positioned in dynamic, interwoven stances. The figures at the foreground have distinct facial features and hair styles. One figure with short, wavy hair and an angular face is seated to the right. Another person is crouched at the left with long, curly hair. Surrounding these figures are lightly sketched individuals with less defined facial details. Some figures are reaching upwards. The background is plain, emphasizing the figures and their actions.

artworks.title: Bird Men
artworks.medium: lithograph with lithotint in black on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures falling and interacting chaotically, centered around a larger central figure. The composition depicts a scene full of movement where several figures appear to be in various poses of falling or floating around a prominent central figure. The figures are sketched with a combination of fine lines and shading to give a sense of depth and movement, with some figures more delineated than others. The drawing uses a monochromatic palette, focusing on line and shading to convey emotions and movement.

artworks.title: Men in Agony
artworks.medium: lithograph with lithotint in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image features three full-body figures in various positions. The top figure is lying on their back with bent knees and one arm under their head. They have short, dark hair and detailed facial features. The second figure is lying on their back with arms outstretched and legs apart. The third figure is standing bent over with their back to the viewer, head hanging down. None of the figures are wearing clothing, and the background is plain and light-colored.

artworks.title: Circling Doves
artworks.medium: transfer lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows two figures in different poses. The figure in the foreground is kneeling and facing forward, with extended arms. The figure behind is standing and facing away. Both have dark hair styled similarly. The kneeling figure wears a necklace. Birds are flying around the figures. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Passing of Dreams
artworks.medium: lithograph with lithotint in black on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of abstract forms and figures. The drawing features several abstractly depicted forms that resemble human figures, sketched lightly with fluid and delicate lines. The figures seem to be intertwined with nature, blending into a backdrop of trees and foliage, rendered with an impressionistic approach using soft, gestural strokes. The use of negative space gives the composition a sense of openness and lightness.

artworks.title: Twelve Men
artworks.medium: lithograph with lithotint in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows fluid, curvilinear shapes creating an abstract composition of human figures in motion. The figures have elongated limbs and torsos resembling dancers in dynamic poses. The abstract depiction connects to human forms in a stylized manner that emphasizes flow and interaction. The arrangement suggests fluidity and grace, akin to a captured moment in a dance or performance.

artworks.title: Recurrence
artworks.medium: lithograph with lithotint in black on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of nude figures amidst abstract vegetative forms. The image features several figures and patterns of foliage or botanical forms. The composition combines human figures in various poses with abstract shapes that suggest a natural environment. The use of lines and shading gives the piece a light, airy feel and highlights the fluidity and interaction between the components of the artwork.

artworks.title: The Judgement of Paris
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythological scene. The image depicts figures gathered in a landscape, engaging in discussion. The style is reminiscent of 18th-century European art. The main figures are in the foreground with flowing drapery, surrounded by trees and a small structure. The landscape includes foliage and rocky terrain. A peacock is in the lower left corner.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Magi with Torches
artworks.artist: Nicolaes Lauwers, after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: Several people are gathered in a group. At the center, a seated woman holds a small, unclothed child on her lap. Surrounding them are several men, some kneeling and others standing, adorned in elaborate garments with intricate detailing. The men have varied facial hair styles. A few figures wear jewelry. The individuals are depicted in poses of adoration or reverence towards the child. The setting is a rustic structure with wooden beams and a thatched roof. In the background, additional figures observe the scene. Dim lighting creates a dramatic contrast, highlighting the main figures in the foreground against the shadowy background with an arched stone opening and wooden stairs.

artworks.title: Christ on the Cross
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a man crucified on a wooden cross with his outstretched arms nailed to the crossbeam. He has long hair and wears a crown of thorns on his head, along with a cloth around his waist. A woman kneels below the cross, grasping it and looking up at the man. Beside her are two others, also looking at the man. In the background, several soldiers, one holding a spear, and a horse are present. The scene is set against a cloudy sky with outlines of distant structures, suggesting a hilly landscape. An inscription is placed above the man's head on the cross. The image is in a monochromatic style with contrasting light and shadow.

artworks.title: The Assumption of the Virgin
artworks.artist: Paulus Pontius, after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper

artworks.title: A Corner of a Studio
artworks.medium: watercolor on wove paper, laid down on cardboard
artworks.description: The image shows a watercolor painting of a still life with a yellow fabric draped in the center and a rose in a glass vase on a wooden surface. The color palette includes dark and earthy tones, with the yellow and pink rose contrasting against the brown and dark green surroundings. The vase with the rose is placed centrally on the yellow fabric, with a stack of blue and white books underneath on the table in the lower middle of the composition. The background displays textured dark brown and green hues.

artworks.title: The Pietà (recto)
artworks.medium: brown ink on laid paper, squared for transfer in red chalk and graphite
artworks.description: The image is an ink and red chalk sketch on paper showing a group of people depicted from the upper bodies and heads. Three main figures are featured, with the central figure possibly representing a religious iconography. This central figure has distinctive features, with outstretched arms and a halo of lines above their head. Surrounding this central figure are two other individuals seated in supporting positions. The figures are wearing drapery-like clothing with no visible jewelry or objects. The background is plain with a faint red chalk grid pattern, indicating this is a preparatory sketch.

artworks.title: A Bacchanale with Egyptian and Classical Figures
artworks.artist: Jean-Philippe-Guy le Gentil, Comte de Paroy, after Charles Monnet
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint with roulette on green prepared laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
image: 11.4 x 55 cm (4 1/2 x 21 5/8 in.)
sheet: 14.7 x 59 cm (5 13/16 x 23 1/4 in.) (irregular)
artworks.description: This is a painting of a decorative frieze with mythological figures and creatures. The image features a symmetrical arrangement of classical figures and mythical themes. There are several nude figures in dynamic poses, interspersed with garland-adorned satyrs and fantastical beasts. The composition is tightly packed and richly detailed. The central figure is framed by garlands held by surrounding figures, and flanked by architectural elements and mythical creatures.

artworks.title: Nashorn Rhinoceros
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a rhinoceros standing in a landscape. The detailed drawing shows the rhinoceros with textured skin and a horn. The animal is in the foreground with a background of grassy terrain and a cloudy sky. The drawing is highly realistic, with meticulous attention to shading and texture. Text at the bottom of the image may provide information about the rhinoceros.

artworks.title: Ein kleiner Abriss von denen Irr= und Abwegen, derer von Gott gerufenen Seelen
artworks.artist: Joseph Bauman, after Heinrich Ezechiel Sangmeister
artworks.medium: ornamental letterpress on laid paper
artworks.description: The image consists of shapes and lines, including circles, curved lines, and radial patterns created by text arrangement. The abstract composition resembles a map or diagram charting celestial movements. Spirals, concentric circles, and outward lines suggest galaxies or planetary orbits, with a sun-like symbol in the upper right corner.
